name: @cloudroom/desktop
description: macOS, Linux, and Windows Electron shell for Cloudroom

scripts.desktop:build: node scripts/cloudroom-version.mjs && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 pnpm run build && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:linux: node scripts/cloudroom-version.mjs && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 pnpm run build && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:build:win: node scripts/cloudroom-version.mjs && pnpm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --x64 --publish never --stamp
scripts.dev: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run build && node --conditions=source --import tsx scripts/run-electron-dev.mjs
scripts.dist: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run desktop:build
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run prepare-runtime && pnpm run desktop:build:linux
scripts.package: pnpm run prepare-runtime && node scripts/cloudroom-version.mjs && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 pnpm run build && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --mac --dir --arm64
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run prepare-runtime && node scripts/cloudroom-version.mjs && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 pnpm run build && BB_CLOUDROOM_STAMP=1 node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --linux --dir --x64
scripts.package:win: pnpm run prepare-runtime && node scripts/cloudroom-version.mjs && pnpm run build && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win --dir --x64 --stamp
